wiki.title: Juandalynn Givan
wiki.extract: Juandalynn Deleathia "Lee Lee" Givan (born 1970/1971) is an American attorney, business owner, and Democratic politician who has served in the Alabama House of Representatives since 2010, representing District 60, which includes parts of Jefferson County, Alabama. In January 2025, she announced her candidacy for Mayor of Birmingham.
